newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan may hold parliament session at end Nov - LDP.
newsitem.headline: Japan may hold parliament session at end Nov - LDP.

text.p: Japan is considering a special session of parliament at the end of November to discuss administrative and tax reforms, an official with the Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) said on Tuesday.

Parliament is due to hold a special session on November 7 to appoint a new premier after the general elections on October 20. Current Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto, the leader of the LDP, is widely expected to be reappointed.
The government will decide by the end of this week the schedule and topics to be discussed in the special session, he added.
